% A test for tex8web: algorithm's ruled float with algpseudocode's lines.
% The caption is at the left between two rules, at the top wherever
% \caption is, and a rule ends the body, as in the PDF, also in an [H]
% float. Each line is indented by its block's depth, with its number in
% the PDF's size; \Statex has neither, and a line without text (\algtext*)
% is left out. A \ref to the algorithm and to one of its lines leads
% there.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[ruled]{algorithm}
\usepackage{algpseudocode}
\begin{document}
\section{Search}
Algorithm~\ref{alg:search} finds the smallest $i$ with $a_i \ge x$; its
loop ends at line~\ref{line:return}.
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Binary search}\label{alg:search}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require a sorted array $a_1 \le \dots \le a_n$ and a value $x$
\Ensure the least $i$ with $a_i \ge x$, or $n+1$
\Function{Search}{$a, x$}
  \State $\ell \gets 1$, $h \gets n + 1$ \Comment{the answer is in $[\ell, h]$}
  \While{$\ell < h$}
    \State $m \gets \lfloor (\ell + h)/2 \rfloor$
    \If{$a_m < x$}
      \State $\ell \gets m + 1$ \Comment{$a_1, \dots, a_m < x$}
    \Else
      \State $h \gets m$
    \EndIf
  \EndWhile
  \State \Return $\ell$\label{line:return}
\EndFunction
\For{$k = 1, \dots, K$}
  \State $s_k \gets \sum_{j=1}^{k} a_j$
\EndFor
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
Text after the algorithm.
